description.zh: 是否全部删除，默认是false。只针对tagkey数组为空时有效。取值范围：-true-false
description.en: Specifies whether to remove all tags. Default value: false. This parameter is valid only when TagKey is left empty. Valid values: true and false.

description.zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为**zh**。取值：
- **zh**：中文
- **en**：英文
description.en:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese
*   **en**: English

The type of the resource. Valid value: Valid values:

*   **DOMAIN**: domain name
The tags added to the resource.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns untag-resources --lang en --resource-type DOMAIN --all false --resource-id example.com --tag-key abcd --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun alidns UntagResources --region cn-hangzhou --All false --ResourceId.1 'example.com' --TagKey.1 abcd --Lang en --ResourceType DOMAIN
